name: Relaunch Tau
description: Relaunches this Tau desktop process: starts a new instance, which unlocks and takes over from this one, and answers as soon as it has started — before the handover. It runs the program this one runs, or the Tau jar named by `jar`: any content reference the venue can resolve for the caller (file://<root>/<path>, such as file://code/brightside/target/brightside.jar for Tau's own build, a DLFS path, an asset), copied in before it starts. Within seconds this process stops, so the work in flight here is cut off and resumes in the new one: a call cut off after this answer was cut off because the relaunch worked, so never relaunch again for that; brightside:info reports the new process id, start time and version. The new instance comes back as this one is (the window, or the tray); with no remembered passphrase it asks the owner for it, and this one runs on until then. Refused while Tau is locked or a relaunch is already under way, and for a jar that is not Tau's. To restart only the venue, brightside:restart is lighter. Venue-operator only.

jar.description: Optional: a content reference to the Tau jar to run, such as file://code/brightside/target/brightside.jar. Omitted, the program this one runs.

accepted.description: True when the new instance was started.

pid.description: The operating-system process id of the new instance.
